one_liner: Offline multi-mode knitting/crochet workshop tool: gauge converter, yardage estimator, size grader and multi-project row counters
target_user: knitters and crocheters adapting patterns to their own gauge and yarn
core_job: convert knitting gauge and estimate yardage for pattern adaptation
primary_interaction: enter measurements -> get converted numbers -> keep per-project counters
wedge_hypothesis: serious knitters juggle gauge math + multiple WIP counters; existing apps are account-based social trackers or single-purpose calculators
